title: fix(console): the language seed's me/localization leaves at parse time, beside discovery
body:
Fixes #35534
Refs #35455

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：新设备首次打开控制台时，取界面语言的请求在页面一开始就发出，不再等整包脚本下载完；托管环境下首屏可少等约一次服务器往返，语言判断结果不变。
- 为什么做：属于“控制台首屏请求串行”专题（托管环境打开要 9–10 秒），这是其中语言请求那一段等待。
- 出错会怎样：最坏情况是首次访问多发一次语言请求，或界面先用默认语言；直接撤回本次合并即可恢复原样。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

On a device's true first visit (no stored language choice, no cached seed), `seedTenantLanguage()` asks `GET /api/v1/auth/me/localization` before React mounts. Asked from the bundle, that request waited for the 105-file eager module graph to download and evaluate. It needs only discovery's `locale.supported`, and discovery is already a parse-time request.

1. **`index.html` gets a parse-time `startEarlyLanguageSeed` script, after `startEarlyDiscovery`.** It applies the seed's own gates: an explicit choice (`objectui-locale`) or a cached seed (`objectui-locale-seed`) sends nothing, and blocked storage reads as neither, as in the seed. Like the seed, it does not wait for the session. It hangs off the parse-time discovery answer and sends the seed's request byte for byte: the same URL through the same `%VITE_SERVER_URL%` substitution, `credentials: 'include'`, the same `Accept`, and the same `Accept-Language`. That header is the browser's language in the app's spelling when `locale.supported` lists it, else none (ruling 6915665005, #34392). The pending `Response` goes into `Symbol.for('objectui.earlyLanguageSeed')`. A failed discovery sends nothing.
2. **`languageSeed.ts` takes it once (`takeEarlySeedRequest`), only when it is the request the seed would send.** The test is an equal `inflightGetKey`: URL, credentials and headers, `Accept-Language` included. The seed hands the parse-time response to the same `sharedGetJson` call as its transport. Unchanged: the in-flight sharing with `LocalizationFetchProvider`, the error path, slice 1's settled-answer hand-off, and the 500 ms race with its fallback. The first look spends the slot, and the script sends nothing after it. So a mismatch, or a script that has not sent yet, leaves exactly one request: the seed's own.
3. **The language ladder is spelled a second time, inside the inline script.** It is `resolveLocaleAmong` over the platform locale table, copied because a classic inline script cannot import. That copy can never change the language: the seed takes only a byte-equal request. A drift therefore costs one extra request, and a matrix pin catches it (Tests). `main.tsx` and `LocalizationFetchProvider.tsx` are not edited.

No spec, server, `ui/packages/**`, endpoint or i18n key is touched.

## Tests

New top-level describe in `ui/apps/console/src/__tests__/sessionCheckBootDedup.test.tsx` (the parse-time harness: it executes the shipped `index.html` scripts against the real modules):

- The script is one inline classic script, placed after the discovery script it reads.
- It leaves once discovery answers, before any bundle code runs, with the stated language (A3 pin 1).
- One cold load, one `me/localization` (A3 pin 2). End to end with `VITE_SERVER_URL` set: the parse-time request, then the real `seedTenantLanguage()` (seed cached before the race resolves, so the locale is still applied before first paint), then the real `LocalizationFetchProvider` served from the seed's settled answer. One request, one discovery.
- Drift pin: the parse-time `Accept-Language` equals the real `pickPreferredLocale()` for every platform tag and read alias (enumerated from `@objectstack/spec/system`, upper-cased too, plus non-table tags) against 34 supported lists.
- CONTROL: a parse-time request the seed would not send is never taken. The seed sends its own, with the right header.
- CONTROL: a stored explicit language choice still wins, and a cached seed still applies. Nothing is sent at parse time or by the seed.
- CONTROL: a signed-out first visit sends one request, as the seed did, and caches nothing.
- CONTROL: the race keeps its bound and its fallback. With the request still open the boot goes on unseeded, the late answer is cached for the next boot, and a provider mounted meanwhile joins the same request.
- CONTROL: a failed parse-time discovery sends nothing early. The seed asks for both itself, once each.
- Blocked storage still sends, as the seed does.

The drift matrix takes 2.7 s.

<details><summary>Readings: A1-A3, built console, before (e25ca63e) and after (this branch)</summary>

Method: a turbo build of the showcase closure and `@object-ui/console` in this tree, then `packages/console/build-dist.sh`, served by `objectstack dev --fresh` from `examples/app-showcase` on a private port. Headless Chromium 1440x900, a new context per load. Resource Timing, plus the CDP initiator of every `me/localization`. Layer = chain depth, as in the #35455 report. cold = cookie only (no Bearer, no stored language, no seed). warm = cookie + Bearer. signed out = no cookie. Shared 4-core box, so the times are shared-box ms.

A1 (before, e25ca63e): the seed's request is module-issued (`framework-*.js` frames) on 15/15 loads. It leaves at 466-563 ms cold, 429-519 ms warm and 451-644 ms signed out. Every load fetched 105 JS files first; the last one ended at 315-514 ms.

A2: the parse-time point with `locale.supported` is the `startEarlyDiscovery` answer. The new script is chained on it. The seed takes the pending `Response` through `sharedGetJson`'s transport argument after an `inflightGetKey` equality check.

| page / posture | me/localization leaves, before | after | initiator before -> after | me/localization count before -> after | chain depth before | after |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| list cold | 529 / 522 / 466 ms | 149 / 81 / 159 ms | module -> inline index.html | 1/1/1 -> 1/1/1 | 9 / 10 / 11 | 10 / 11 / 11 |
| record cold | 563 / 561 / 506 | 86 / 83 / 166 | module -> inline | 1/1/1 -> 1/1/1 | 12 / 12 / 11 | 12 / 12 / 12 |
| list warm | 456 / 466 / 519 | 121 / 176 / 187 | module -> inline | 1/1/1 -> 1/1/1 | 10 / 11 / 10 | 9 / 11 / 11 |
| record warm | 474 / 491 / 429 | 133 / 159 / 93 | module -> inline | 1/1/1 -> 1/1/1 | 12 / 11 / 12 | 12 / 11 / 12 |
| signed out (lands on /login) | 451 / 636 / 644 | 116 / 137 / 199 | module -> inline | 1/1/1 -> 1/1/1 | 4 / 4 / 4 | 4 / 4 / 4 |

The request keeps its layer (L2, after discovery), so chain depth does not move. The gain is wall time on the path to the mount: locally the seed's own round trip was 10-17 ms, so the local mount barely moves. Latency probe (`me/localization` responses held 300 ms, list cold, 3 loads each): the first post-mount request (`me/permissions`) left at 937 / 993 / 935 ms before and 610 / 551 / 552 ms after. The first data read left at 1946 / 2211 / 1634 ms before and 1664 / 1601 / 1483 ms after. Every load stated `Accept-Language: en` in both builds, the same language.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The language ladder now has a third spelling, in `index.html`, beside `resolveLocaleAmong` and the spec table it reads. The inline script cannot import, and the alternatives were outside this card's fence: a build-time HTML transform in `vite.config.ts`, or a server change. A drift there costs one request and never a language, because the seed takes only a byte-equal request. The drift pin enumerates the spec's own table, so a new tag or alias in the spec reds this test until the inline copy follows.
- The owner count for the slice-1 hand-off is read when the seed takes the request, as before. The parse-time request carries the cookie session the page was loaded with, the same session the discovery and get-session hand-offs already assume.
- A1 also shows the signed-out first visit sends `me/localization` (answered `authenticated: false`). That is unchanged and kept on purpose: the seed has never waited on the session, and the dispatch says to keep what it does today.

## Verification

Read first, by risk: `ui/apps/console/index.html` `startEarlyLanguageSeed` (the gates and `resolveAmong`); `ui/apps/console/src/languageSeed.ts` `takeEarlySeedRequest` and the `sharedGetJson` transport argument; the new describe's drift-matrix test.

Two minutes: `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run apps/console/src/__tests__/sessionCheckBootDedup.test.tsx`. Expect 48 tests green, 11 of them in the describe named for this card.
